structure.joint_law: Each row draws one correlated five-dimensional standard-normal vector. Age is an adult-shifted lognormal; BMI, TC and HDL are lognormal; sex is a thresholded latent coordinate. All latent pairs are specified. The continuous BMI-lipid submatrix transports three unadjusted rural Ashanti rank statistics, while age/sex dependencies are explicit assumptions. Conditional raw-scale associations follow from this complete joint law rather than being assigned source coefficients.
structure.composition: The assumed marginal age mean is 40 years with SD 15 years, with half the population assigned each recorded sex code in expectation. BMI composition is specified marginally, not by importing source sex-specific mixtures. No site, lifestyle or health-state mixture is inferred. Their effects are left implicit in the chosen observed-scale joint distribution.
structure.support: Age has support above 18 with no finite upper endpoint. BMI and both lipids are strictly positive with unbounded upper tails. Continuous boundary points have zero probability. There is no TC>=HDL restriction, rounding, outlier deletion or additional health/fasting exclusion.

population_moments_for_estimands.notation: B=bmi, T=total_cholesterol, H=hdl_cholesterol, F=I(sex=='F'), U=(age,F), Q=(age,F,B). Sigma is the centered population covariance matrix of (age,F,B,T,H), in delivered raw units. R denotes the constructed latent correlation matrix.
population_moments_for_estimands.continuous_moments: For continuous variable j, let m_j=positive_mean, d_j=positive_sd, o_j=offset and s_j=sqrt(log(1+(d_j/m_j)^2)). Then E[Y_j]=o_j+m_j and Sigma_ij=m_i*m_j*expm1(R_ij*s_i*s_j). This also gives the specified marginal variances on the diagonal.
population_moments_for_estimands.sex_moments: Let p=upper_probability and q=Phi_inverse(1-p). E[F]=p, Var(F)=p*(1-p), and Cov(Y_j,F)=m_j*(Phi(R_j,sex*s_j-q)-p). Offsets do not affect covariance.
population_moments_for_estimands.interpretation: These moment identities identify the population linear projections, including effects of covariate composition and nonlinear marginal transformations. Numerical scalar evaluation of the projection formulas has not been performed.

requested_estimands.derivation_or_reason: This is the population OLS BMI coefficient after residualizing BMI and HDL against intercept, age and recorded F, multiplied by the requested BMI contrast and numerical lipid conversion. Sigma is determined by the analytic moment identities in structure. The numerical scalar has not been evaluated; neither a source rank nor a finite-sample fit is substituted.

This is the population OLS BMI coefficient after residualizing BMI and TC against intercept, age and recorded F, multiplied by the requested BMI contrast and numerical lipid conversion. Sigma is determined by the analytic moment identities in structure. The numerical scalar has not been evaluated.

The Schur-complement covariance and variances give the Pearson correlation after separate population linear projections of TC and HDL onto intercept, age, recorded F and BMI. limitations: This is one explicit, assumption-completed scenario, not an identified estimate of Turkana 2018-2019 outcomes or demographic composition. No excluded target outcomes are used.

The construction combines Navrongo pooled arithmetic moments with rural Ashanti ranks and assumed age/sex relationships. It does not reconstruct either source cohort or demonstrate compatibility with all their statistics.
The evidence does not identify target age, sex, BMI, lifestyle or site mixtures. No national representativeness, actual sampling-cluster independence or causal interpretation is claimed.

Agongo's univariate log-lipid regressions are omitted because the log base is unresolved and their operator differs from the requested conditional raw-scale projection. Greiner regressions are omitted because transformations and adjustment bridges are unresolved. Neither is silently converted into a requested slope.

Greiner geometric means, threshold percentages and age quartiles are not used as additional calibration constraints. They are not arithmetic means, individual SDs or independent replications of other same-cohort summaries. Urban Ashanti ranks are also deliberately omitted rather than averaged into an unsupported target mixture.
Source selection, fasting, specimen and instrument differences remain uncorrected transport assumptions. The task's factor 38.67 is numerical mmol/L-to-mg/dL conversion only, not assay equivalence.

Uncertainty is conditional on fixed scientific settings. Seed-to-seed variation represents synthetic individual sampling, not source estimation uncertainty, model-form uncertainty or transport uncertainty.
Lognormal tails, smooth interview ages and lack of a TC>=HDL constraint are explicit modeling choices. They are not authenticated features of the target measurements.
Curator extraction claims and original locators are historical supplied provenance. No original article reauthentication, code execution or numerical population-projection evaluation is claimed.
